title: Open your shop
headline: Open your *shop*
sub: Sign up, tell Taskiem about your business, and be found.

bridge.en: Ada's Kitchen is on Taskiem. Now, what goes on the menu?
bridge.pcm: Ada's Kitchen don dey Taskiem. Now, wetin go dey the menu?

flow.purpose: cold open: Ada with a buzzing phone
flow.action: Stirs a pot of jollof while her phone buzzes; she glances at it, laughs and shakes her head
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer

flow.action: Looks at an empty chalkboard menu on the wall, then at a pot of jollof, and nods with her hands on her hips
